tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. A cool off-white with a slight ledger-green bias; never pure white for the page.

tokens.name: paper-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, offering panels, dialogs and tables that sit on paper.

tokens.name: paper-sunk
tokens.usage: Table header rows, key-terms panels, code and identifier wells.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules and card borders. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input and secondary-button borders. Holds 3:1 on paper and paper-raised in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and figures, on paper, paper-raised, paper-sunk and ledger-soft (14:1 or better in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, captions and table labels, on paper, paper-raised and paper-sunk (6:1 or better).

tokens.name: ledger
tokens.usage: The brand colour. Primary actions, active states, links and equity instruments; as text on paper, paper-raised and ledger-soft (5.8:1 or better).

tokens.name: ledger-deep
tokens.usage: Large brand fields: the site header band, hero slabs, the cover. Text on it is on-deep.

tokens.name: ledger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind ledger or ink text: selected rows, equity tags, info panels.

tokens.name: on-ledger
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a ledger fill, such as the primary button label. Never literal white.

tokens.name: on-deep
tokens.usage: Text and icons on ledger-deep (14:1 light, 8:1 dark).

tokens.name: seal
tokens.usage: Brass, from the seal on a share certificate. Bonds and fixed-income instruments, and the pending state; as text on paper, paper-raised and seal-soft (4.6:1 or better).

tokens.name: seal-fill
tokens.usage: Solid brass fields: the cover, illustrations, bond charts. Text on it is on-seal.

tokens.name: seal-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind seal text: bond tags, pending notices.

tokens.name: on-seal
tokens.usage: Text on seal-fill (6:1 light, 9:1 dark).

tokens.name: settled
tokens.usage: Success: settled, issued, verified. Blue rather than green so it never relies on red-green hue alone; always paired with a word. As text on paper, paper-raised and settled-soft.

tokens.name: settled-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind settled text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, failed transfers, halted trading, and the risk icon in risk notices; as text on paper, paper-raised and danger-soft. Always paired with a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind danger text.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links. An alias of ledger, so a theme that moves ledger moves links.

groups.name: Poppins
groups.note: Poppins is the only brand face, loaded from Google Fonts in weights 400, 500 and 600. Poppins sets wide, so sizes run a step smaller than in narrower faces.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the hero headline on marketing pages.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Each token represents one ordinary share recorded on the issuer's register.
styles.usage: Running text. Keep lines near 65 characters.

styles.name: small
styles.sample: Wholesale investors only. Minimum investment A$10,000.
styles.usage: Table cells, helper text, the risk notice body.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Headline numbers on offering cards and portfolios. Set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase field labels, table headers and instrument tags.

groups.name: Identifiers
groups.note: The one exception to Poppins: machine identifiers that people copy or compare character by character.

styles.name: identifier
styles.usage: ISINs, token contract addresses, transaction hashes and register references. Never for prose or amounts.

spacing.note: 4px base. Generous whitespace reads as calm and considered; dense layouts are kept for tables.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; gap between unit tiles.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and compact controls.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between label and value; table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inside buttons (horizontal); mobile page gutter.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between page sections on mobile.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between page sections on desktop.

radius.note: Squared and precise, like a certificate's border. Nothing is fully round except the focus ring following its control.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Unit tiles, instrument tags, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, dialogs.

shadow.note: Borders carry structure; shadow is reserved for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs only. Cards use a line border instead.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px paper gap, then 2px of solid settled blue (5.5:1 or better on every surface). Blue so it stays distinct from ledger-filled buttons.
